prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Create a completely NEW refined 16:9 key frame for the historical narrative game 逆转五丈原. VERSION D: exquisite natural cinematic realism. This is a fresh production design, not a filter or a pixel-preserving edit.
REFERENCE ROLES: image 1 is ONLY Wei Yan's character identity sketch: middle-aged Chinese man, angular broad face, strong brows, dark moustache and pointed beard, practical dark helmet, dark lamellar armor over subdued oxblood cloth. Do not inherit image 1's carved skin, embossed cloth, excessively outlined armor or CG gloss. Image 2 is ONLY lighting and depth reference: layered hazy silhouettes, wet materials with selective directional glints, sparse compositional hierarchy, misty air. Do not copy its swordsman, pagoda, rooftops, wuxia setting or any UI.
SCENE: Wei Yan quietly hears a report outside a modest Three Kingdoms canvas command tent at Wuzhang Plains. One scout's blurred shoulder occupies the extreme left edge, Wei Yan is at right third in a waist-up medium shot, body at a natural three-quarter angle, eyes focused on the scout, mouth relaxed with restrained concern rather than aggressive scowl. His silhouette occupies no more than 40% frame width. Background opens to a simple timber walkway and distant camp standards, soft low hills. Avoid crowds and background clutter.
ART DIRECTION: believable handsome character casting with strong but subtle facial planes. Fine luminous skin with soft subsurface color, small natural pores, individual fine beard hairs; no plastic, embossed wrinkles, oily cheeks or extreme age lines. Skilled handmade costume: unpatterned deep claret linen showing fine weave and natural broad folds; blackened iron lamellae arranged with clear structural hierarchy, broad matte planes and tiny irregular glints, no gold rivet decoration. Well-designed silhouette and tactile restrained craftsmanship.
PHOTOGRAPHY: bright soft overcast daylight, gentle directional side illumination across cheek, warm skin versus cool grey-green atmosphere. Dark eye pupils naturally crisp, cheeks softly modulated. Deepest shadows still dimensional; subtle lens diffusion on highlights, no sharpening halos. Shallow optical focus gracefully separates face and costume from background while retaining spatial context. Soft neutral mist beyond the camp only. Mostly matte damp earth, one small selective glint on a damp timber rail. Muted green-grey distance, taupe tent, natural warm skin, rich but restrained dark red sleeve. No orange rims or numerous fires. Fine restrained film grain, high-quality production photography, refined rather than gritty.
OUTPUT: a finished beautiful live-action historical cinema frame, full color, no text, letters, captions, watermarks, logos, border or montage. Do not reproduce the previous image composition exactly. No fantasy architecture or magic.
role: Existing Wei Yan image as identity reference; user screenshot as atmosphere reference
